primary_row_metric: Raw corrupted-batch union of fixed baseline and selected candidates vs labelled rows
increment: Candidate alerts beyond the same fixed baseline on the same batch
delta_diagnostic: Union of baseline new alerts and per-candidate new alerts relative to unmodified source; reported separately
why: Subtracting aggregate before/after union can mask additional findings when baseline already flagged an unmodified row
protocol_deviation: published_benchmark_generation mentions development samples; actual prompts contain schemas and provisional source descriptions only, no data rows or error labels
parallelism: One inference slot. Two clients briefly queued requests during benchmark generation; walltime can include queueing. No concurrent model evaluation slots.
